items.label: USAO-MA civil: Study Across the Pond, LLC
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement (qui tam, United States ex rel. Hitrost LLC v. Study Across the Pond, LLC, No. 21-CV-10274-ADB, D. Mass.) over contracts that paid the firm a share of U.S. students' tuition at UK schools, against the Higher Education Act incentive-compensation ban; date is the announcement date. The release states the firm 'and its principal, John Borhaug, have agreed to pay $1.3 million' with no split between them, so the row stays in gross and counts for no company (shared total, split not stated). Facts admitted in the settlement agreement. The government's April 2024 complaint states the firm is organized under Massachusetts law with its principal place of business in Beverly. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2026-study-across-the-pond; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: One settlement, company and its principal, no split and no statement that the company pays it all; the settlement agreement is not linked from the release. Source (read 2026-10-12): "Study Across the Pond, LLC (SATP) and its principal, John Borhaug, have agreed to pay $1.3 million". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so no company's own share is stated and the amount is counted for no company; it stays in gross.
excluded_amounts.category_label: Split not stated by the source (cash from relief, or between payers)
